name: Aries PureDream
source:
The protagonist Shinichi Hirose is peacefully attending a perfectly normal school when his world suddenly becomes upside-down.

Just as in the game it's based on, an angel studying at a special angel school descend to earth to learn more about humans and love in particular.

PureDream focuses on the heroines Ami, Inaho, Taeko, Megumi & Rinrin.
translation:
主人公广濑真一原本平静地就读于一所再普通不过的学校，他的世界却突然发生了翻天覆地的变化。

与本作所改编的游戏一样，一名就读于特殊天使学校的天使降临人间，学习人类的种种，尤其是爱情。

《PureDream》主要讲述亚美、稻穗、妙子、惠与琳琳几位女主角的故事。
